official_definition: [Six Heaven Rush (Condition: X Symbol Colors)] While you have X or more colors of symbols, the following effect is activated.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Six Heaven Rush] or [Six Heaven Rush: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Six Heaven Rush]", "give [Six Heaven Rush]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
